source.name: In-Out Electric Smelter
source.ports: Ore in and plates out both on the west side; no ore leaves the station, so copies cannot share one ore line without extra belts.

inputs.label: Ore in
inputs.note: One red belt into the west face of the splitter on row 1. The station takes 1,800 ore per minute first; everything else continues east.

outputs.label: Plates out
outputs.note: One red belt leaving the south edge in the last column, 1,800 plates per minute.

forward.label: Ore out (forwarded)
forward.note: The same row as the entrance; 0 ore per minute from a full red belt. A copy placed 30 tiles east takes it with no extra belts; on the last copy it may stay unconnected.

ports.label: Ore in
ports.note: One red belt into the west face of the splitter on row 1. The station takes 1,800 ore per minute first; everything else continues east.

ports.label: Ore out (forwarded)
ports.note: The same row as the entrance; 0 ore per minute from a full red belt. A copy placed 30 tiles east takes it with no extra belts; on the last copy it may stay unconnected.

ports.label: Plates out
ports.note: One red belt leaving the south edge in the last column, 1,800 plates per minute.

chaining.note: Place the next copy 30 tiles east (touching). One red belt (1,800 ore/min) feeds 1 copy at full rate. The ore line inside each copy is red, so a faster belt is held to 1,800 per minute inside the first copy.

setupNotes: Official 2.1.24 Space Age. Speed modules, tier three: 24 electric furnaces with 48 speed module 3s (2 in each furnace), fast inserters, red belts, red underground belts and red splitters, 4 substations, 2 roboports. Derived from the Autosaved "In-Out Electric Smelter" (autosaved-f3d991e31c13c301, https://autosaved.org/factorio/blueprints). WEST: ore in on one red belt, row 1 (second row). The station takes 1,800 ore per minute first; the rest leaves EAST on the same row, so copies placed 30 tiles apart chain along one ore line (one red belt feeds 1 copy). SOUTH: 1,800 plates per minute on one red belt in the last column. Iron or copper ore; a blocked plate exit or a full station never stops the ore line, and an unconnected east end does not stop the station. Supply electricity at any substation; copies placed side by side join one network.
Feed iron ore or copper ore, one kind per ore line. Each was tested on its own; mixed ore on one line was not tested.
Keep the splitter priorities: the entrance splitter sends ore to the station first (south output); the merge splitter sends plates to the exit column.
